decision.reason: [ev-7a3fdefaaff7] says only that "the service account template" was fixed to handle boolean annotation values. It doesn't name the Helm values key, and it doesn't say which of the chart's service accounts is affected. The proposed exposure, serviceAccount.annotations set, is also too broad: it would flag every environment that sets any annotation, not only environments that set boolean-valued ones. The surrounding section adds nothing about this item, and the values validator was inconclusive. Deciding this needs the PR #7698 template diff or the chart values paths it touches.
